definitions.explanation: Consisting of many different kinds of things mixed together without particular order.

examples.japanese: {雑多|ざった}な⟦{品物|しなもの}→品物：00886_shinamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
{雑多|ざった}な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{交|か}う。
examples.english: Various kinds of information are flying around.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雑多|ざった}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{所狭|ところせま}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{置|お}かれている→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: This shop is crammed with a diverse assortment of goods.

notes:
{雑多|ざった} describes a state of being mixed with various different things. It can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{雑然|ざつぜん}→雑然：09236_zatsuzen⟧: cluttered, disorderly (more negative, emphasizes disorder)
- ⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧: diverse (more positive, emphasizes variety)
- ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧: various (neutral)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑多|ざった}な⟦{品物|しなもの}→品物：00886_shinamono⟧: miscellaneous goods
- {雑多|ざった}な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: various kinds of information
- {雑多|ざった}な⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧: diverse people
